comments.body:
Updated the 20 use-case flows and their collaboration diagrams to match the current features. The four wireflows show the success, validation and error states, with teammate feature work kept separate.

[Model crosswalk](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ee17b630c7d034f4f49898ebcc03035a835ce473/docs/iteration-17/work-breakdown/model/model-traceability.json)

Reopened the committed native model and checked the diagrams. All 20 use-case flows and 24 screen states matched the prepared changes, and the 28 screen/wireflow renders matched. The incoming teammate view changes are recorded separately.

[Publication checks](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ee17b630c7d034f4f49898ebcc03035a835ce473/docs/iteration-17/work-breakdown/model/publication-checks.json)

Published this model work in shared Visual Paradigm revision 65. The committed copy was verified with no pending history, and the native project and publication proof are on main.

[Publication proof](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ee17b630c7d034f4f49898ebcc03035a835ce473/docs/iteration-17/work-breakdown/model/publication-checks.json)

Finished the model and Jira work breakdown. The use-case flows, design diagrams and screen flows match the implemented features, and the work items link to their requirements and test evidence.

The model work is published in Visual Paradigm revision 65. The functional overview and shot wireflow below are exports from that revision.
